subtitle.zh: AI-FDE 转型之路 · AI 工程 09-Agent设计与实现
subtitle.en: The AI-FDE Transition Path · AI Engineering 09 — Agent Design and Implementation

summary.zh: Agent 不是更聪明的模型，而是让模型能动手的一段程序：一个循环、三层刹车、最小闭环、停止线、观察能力与文件四件套。
summary.en: An agent is not a smarter model but a program that lets the model act: one loop, three layers of brakes, a minimal loop, stop lines, observability, and four file tools.
